title: First-party talent opt-in (Demigod)
description: Schema for talent who opt in via a first-party form (e.g. trydemigod). Never populated by LinkedIn scrape or people-data brokers. Fixtures must set dataMarker=SYNTHETIC; live intake uses FIRST_PARTY after the form ships.

optInId.description: Stable id for this opt-in row (UUID).

consentedAt.description: When the talent consented to first-party matching.

consentVersion.description: Version string of the consent copy the talent accepted.

rolesInterested.description: Role titles or families the talent wants to be considered for.

workAuthUS.description: Whether the talent self-attests US work authorization.

cheapTalkExpectations.description: Self-reported expectations (comp band, pace, constraints) — cheap talk, not verified.

contactHandleType.description: Channel type for later mutual-yes contact. Identity stays private until dual yes.

contactHandleValue.description: OPTIONAL. Placeholder-only in fixtures (.invalid). Real values never written by scrape; only from first-party form after live intake.

status.description: active = eligible for dry-run/live rank; revoked = must not rank.

dataMarker.description: REQUIRED provenance. SYNTHETIC = dry-run fixtures only. FIRST_PARTY = real opt-in from Demigod form (never scrape).

displayName.description: Optional dry-run / operator label. Fixtures must include SYNTHETIC in the string. Not required for live FIRST_PARTY (identity private until mutual yes).

scorecardNotes.description: Optional operator/dry-run enrichment for ranking heuristics. Not collected by the public opt-in form.
